jobs.text: Night city street ambience: a low hum of distant traffic, a faint far-off siren now and then, light wind and the buzz of a street lamp. Seamless ambient loop only, steady and unobtrusive, no music, no voices, no sudden loud events.

Rooftop at night ambience: steady wind, a distant hum of city traffic far below, a faint air-conditioner fan drone and a rattle of loose sheet metal now and then. Seamless ambient loop only, steady and unobtrusive, no music, no voices, no sudden loud events.
